latest_release.body:
[8.1.0 (2026-10-27)](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#8.1.0)
========================================================================================================================

Thanks to
[@BillyLiou](https://github.com/BillyLiou),
[@Thomasdezeeuw](https://github.com/Thomasdezeeuw),
[@eyupcanakman](https://github.com/eyupcanakman),
[@fubar-coder](https://github.com/fubar-coder),
[@ptwales](https://github.com/ptwales),
[@jgarte](https://github.com/jgarte),
[@brenordv](https://github.com/brenordv),
[@linkdd](https://github.com/linkdd),
[@jkellz-dev](https://github.com/jkellz-dev),
[@josh-coderpad](https://github.com/josh-coderpad),
[@qrn12580](https://github.com/qrn12580),
[@1diot9](https://github.com/1diot9),
[@Hama1cco](https://github.com/Hama1cco),

[Take a tour of this version here!](https://hurl.dev/blog/2026/10/28/hurl-8.1.0-of-config-and-security.html)

Enhancements:

* Add --no-header option to remove specific HTTP header [#4884](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/4884)
* Add --fail-with-body option to output response body when there are errors [#4776](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/4776)
* Add no jsonpath coercion option [#5077](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5077)
* Add --proxy-header option to send header exclusively to a proxy [#3944](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/3944)
* Add --http2-prior-knowledge command line option to use HTTP/2 without HTTP/1.1 Upgrade [#5126](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5126)
* Re-export Input struct from hurl_core to hurl [#5128](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5128)
* Add Sublime Text syntax highlighting [#5298](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5298)
* Add --tls-max option [#3713](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/3713)
* Skip suggestion fo very long keyword [#5360](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5360)
* Add --tls-min option to set the minimum allowed TLS version [#5335](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5335)
* Add Hurl config file [#3629](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/3629)


Bugs Fixed:

* Fix misleading error message for not-equal predicate [#2841](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/2841)
* Fix variable option values starting with a number or boolean [#5028](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5028)
* Fix recorded headers when connecting to proxy with CONNECT [#5091](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5091)
* Fix Hurl debug curl command when request binary body contains NUL char [#5141](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5141)
* Don't fail build on Windows if file icon is not reachable [#5207](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5207)
* Fix parsing exponent in JSONPath expr [#5342](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5342)
* Add explicit nesting limit to JSONPath expression parsing [#5350](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5350)
* Fix hurlfmt panic when importing curl commands without a URL [#5354](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5354)
* Fix crash when receiving non UTF-8 server cookie [#5356](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5356)
* Fix crash for bad `@cookie_storage_set` comment (experimental feature) [#5348](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5348)
* Parse finite float in JSONPath [#5330](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5330)
* Escape curl command from --curl option and --verbose log [#5374](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5374)


Security Issues Fixed:

* Fix CVE-2026-63481 stripping cookie from Cookies section when redirecting to a different host [#5118](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5118)
* Fix escaping headers values in HTML report [#5228](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl/issues/5228)
* Fix symlinks es
